verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI can run non-interactively in scripts (gemini-cli-gh-6) and be invoked via GitHub Actions for PR reviews/issue triage (gemini-cli-gh-10, gemini-cli-gh-11), but these are event-triggered or manually-scripted invocations, not a built-in scheduler or recurring-job/cron feature. No evidence describes any native job-scheduling, cron-like triggers, or persistent recurring workflow management. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling/cron capability, recurring trigger configuration, or workflow orchestration for repeated runs.
